question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Inquisitive
solution:
The correct answer is "**Curious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Inquisitive" means having or showing an interest in learning things; curious**.(जिज्ञासु)

 
 
• Example: She was an inquisitive child and always asked questions about everything.
 
 
 
• **​"Curious" means wanting to know or learn something. **(कुतूहली)
 
 
• ​Example: He was curious to know how the system worked.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​Thus, it can be concluded that the word "curious" is the synonym of the word "inquisitive."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1, "Agile" means able to move quickly and easily; nimble. (चुस्त)
 
• In option 2, "Aloof" means not friendly or forthcoming; cool and distant. (अलग)
 
• In option 3, "Callous" means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (कठोर)
